requirement: The system shall authenticate all users before granting access to protected resources.
remarks: Verified with SSO integration test on 2025-03-10.
customer_remarks: Authentication works as expected. No issues observed during UAT.

requirement: All data transmissions must use TLS 1.2 or higher encryption.
customer_remarks: We confirmed TLS 1.3 is used on all endpoints. Satisfactory.

requirement: The application must provide an audit log of all administrative actions with timestamps.
remarks: Logging is in place but timestamps are missing timezone info.
customer_remarks: Audit logs are present but the missing timezone causes confusion when correlating with our own logs. Please resolve before go-live.

requirement: Password policy must enforce a minimum length of 12 characters including special characters.
customer_remarks: This is a blocker for us. Our security policy requires 12+ characters minimum. Cannot accept delivery until resolved.

requirement: System must support multi-factor authentication for all privileged accounts.
customer_remarks: MFA tested and working with both TOTP and hardware keys. Approved.

requirement: Backup and recovery procedures must be documented and tested quarterly.
remarks: Handled by infrastructure team, out of scope.

requirement: All API endpoints must validate and sanitize input to prevent injection attacks.
remarks: Legacy endpoint /api/v1/query not yet updated. Sprint 42.
customer_remarks: We ran a basic penetration test and confirmed the vulnerability. This must be fixed before production deployment.

requirement: The system must lock accounts after 5 consecutive failed authentication attempts.
customer_remarks: Tested and confirmed. Lockout triggers correctly and unlock procedure is clear.

requirement: Session tokens must expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
remarks: Timeout implemented but not enforced for API sessions.
customer_remarks: Web sessions time out correctly. However our integration team noticed API sessions remain active indefinitely. Needs to be fixed.

requirement: All sensitive data fields must be masked in application logs.
remarks: Credit card numbers still appear in debug logs. PR #891 in review.
customer_remarks: We discovered this during log review. Unacceptable for PCI compliance. High priority fix required.

requirement: The application must comply with GDPR data retention policies.
remarks: Retention policy enforced via scheduled cleanup job.
customer_remarks: Reviewed the cleanup job configuration and data flow. Compliant with our GDPR obligations.

requirement: Role-based access control must be enforced for all resource types.
customer_remarks: RBAC verified across all tested resource types. Works as specified.

requirement: The system must provide a mechanism for users to export their personal data.
remarks: Feature not applicable to this deployment context.

requirement: All third-party dependencies must be scanned for known vulnerabilities monthly.
remarks: Scanning in place but remediation SLA not yet defined.
customer_remarks: Scanning is good but we need a defined SLA for remediation. Please provide a written policy document.

requirement: Error messages must not expose internal system details to end users.
remarks: Stack traces visible in production for unhandled exceptions.
customer_remarks: We reproduced this on the staging environment. Stack traces reveal internal paths and library versions. Must be fixed.
